question.text: Under SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020, Investment Approach refers to:

answer.text: The personal investment style of the principal officer
A broad outlay of the type of securities and permissible instruments for the investor
The risk appetite of the custodian

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XXI-A workbook (pages 100 and 128), Investment Approach is a broad outlay of the type of securities and permissible instruments to be invested in by the portfolio manager for the customer or investor. The Trap: Personal style of the principal officer or the custodian's risk appetite are separate concepts unrelated to the regulatory definition of Investment Approach. Note: Workbook pages 100 and 128 are the source for this definition.
